label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off: the survey team recorded an object that looked like explosive ordnance (E2), which is direct evidence and a target. The programme provides no technical survey, so its criteria direct a target to clearance. E1 reports only four years of trouble-free fishing by one land user and does not meet cancellation criteria or explain E2.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E2.

E1.quote: A man who hunts and fishes said he started to fish along one of the streams in the area 4 years ago and has had no trouble there.
E1.note: A land user reports four years of trouble-free fishing, supporting absence over that period; one source and less than five years do not meet cancellation criteria.

E2.quote: The survey team saw an object that looked like explosive ordnance on the ground near the old path to the school.
E2.note: The survey team's own recorded observation of an object that looked like EO is direct evidence and a target; absence evidence cannot explain it away.
